reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: mint_ctokens has a production caller at market.move:285 (not dead code). Gate 2: no trust_assumptions in scope file; attack entry point is the permissionless public deposit function (untrusted). Gate 3: reserve.move is explicitly in scope. An attacker can trigger this via the deposit entry point by becoming the first depositor then accruing interest to push exchange_rate above 1, causing a subsequent victim deposit of 1 unit to receive 0 ctokens via int_div truncation (confirmed at L160), while the victim's funds inflate the reserve and are recoverable by the attacker on redemption.
